blocks.text: Runbook: hoist and jack-stand safety

This is the working cut for RDW-RB-2023-077 on May 25, 2023. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Floor jack for 'just a minute' looks) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host hoist.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on quick look under a truck on a floor jack, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Locks engaged. Stands at rated points. No walking under a truck on a jack only. Red-tag a hoist with a spongy pedal. I am not restating a hallway yes. quick look under a truck on a floor jack is out because May 8 quick look is how a jack rolled on a slope in the lot. Nobody was under it. Next time they might be. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: stands=2, slope=1, weeks=2, pedal=1, minute=1, lot=1, under=0, tag=1. Sibling tickets RDW-2955 and RDW-SOP-2022-062. I will not reopen quick look under a truck on a floor jack in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
